SaffronCity_Text_WhatDoYouWantGetLost: What do you want? Get lost!
SaffronCity_Text_BossTakeTownForTeamRock: BOSS said he'll take this town in the name of TEAM ROCKET!
SaffronCity_Text_DontGetDefiantOrIllHurt: Don't get defiant! Or I'll have to hurt you!
SaffronCity_Text_CriminalLifeMakesMeFeel: My life as a criminal makes me feel so alive!
SaffronCity_Text_WeCanExploitMonsAroundW:
With SILPH under control, we can exploit POKéMON around the world!
We'll get stinking rich, yeahah!
SaffronCity_Text_YouBeatTeamRocket: You beat TEAM ROCKET all alone? That's amazing!
SaffronCity_Text_SafeToGoOutAgain: Yeah! TEAM ROCKET is gone! It's safe to go out again!
SaffronCity_Text_PeopleComingBackToSaffr:
People fled from here in droves when those ROCKETS came.
They should be flocking back to SAFFRON now.
SaffronCity_Text_FlewHereOnPidgeot:
I flew here on my PIDGEOT when I read about SILPH.
It's already over? I missed the media action…
SaffronCity_Text_SawRocketBossEscaping: I saw the ROCKET BOSS escaping SILPH's building.
SaffronCity_Text_ImASecurityGuard:
I'm a security guard.
Suspicious kids I don't allow in!
SaffronCity_Text_HesTakingASnooze:
… Snore…
Hah! He's taking a snooze!
SaffronCity_Text_CitySign: SAFFRON CITY Shining, Golden Land of Commerce
SaffronCity_Text_GymSign: SAFFRON CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: SABRINA The Master of PSYCHIC POKéMON!
SaffronCity_Text_FullHealCuresStatus:
TRAINER TIPS
FULL HEAL cures all ailments like burns, paralysis, poisoning, freezing, and sleep.
It costs a bit more, but it's more convenient than buying other items.
SaffronCity_Text_GreatBallImprovedCatchR:
TRAINER TIPS
The new GREAT BALL offers improved catching rates.
Try it on those hard-to-catch POKéMON.
SaffronCity_Text_SilphsLatestProduct: SILPH's latest product! Release to be determined…
SaffronCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign:
POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB
Many TRAINERS have scribbled their names on this sign.
SaffronCity_Text_HowCanClubNotRecognizeL:
This FAN CLUB… No one here has a clue!
How could they not recognize the brilliance that is LANCE?
He stands for justice! He's cool, and yet passionate! He's the greatest, LANCE!
